documents.title: Muru
documents.summary: Muru Graham Dumpleton started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, and has been thinking about the ideal way to serve Python web applications in production ever since. Muru is his new, AI-assisted Rust server that aims to provide the best possible tools for running ASGI and WSGI Python apps both in development and production. As he did with wrapture , he's been publishing an extraordinarily detailed account of the project as he works on it - as part of his development process.
